question: 累计消费金额最高的5位用户是哪些？（请给出用户名与累计非取消实付金额）
gold_sql: SELECT u.username, ROUND(SUM(o.total_amount), 2) AS total_spent FROM users u JOIN orders o ON o.user_id = u.id WHERE o.status != 'cancelled' GROUP BY u.id, u.username ORDER BY total_spent DESC, u.id LIMIT 5
